_help.must_fill_in: These cannot be null or placeholders; the validator rejects the file: related_transmit_experiment_id, receiver_instrument_model, capture_timestamp (ISO 8601), capture_sample_rate_Sa_per_s, symbol_rate_Bd, receiver_bandwidth_Hz, fiber_length_km, attenuation_dB, symbol_probabilities, split, data_source, units.
_help.null_means_not_measured: optical_received_power_dBm must be present. null means not measured, and it is shown as 'not recorded' in the fairness audit. Never estimate it.
_help.optional_may_be_null_or_removed: optical_launch_power_dBm, oma_dBm, extinction_ratio_dB, awg_sample_rate_Sa_per_s, electrical_amplitude_Vpp, modulator_parameters, calibration, operator_notes. Leave null if you did not measure it. Do not estimate it.
_help.ignored_by_the_validator: This _help block is ignored; delete it if you like.
